questions.prompt: A Recovery Services vault has policy-based immutability Enabled and locked. Existing recovery points have not reached their retention expiry. An administrator wants to retire the source VM while preserving those points. Which action is permitted by immutability?

options.text: Stop protection while retaining the existing backup data.
options.explanation: Immutability permits stopping protection with retained data; it does not permit premature deletion of the protected recovery points.

options.text: Disable locked immutability, then delete the existing backup data.
options.explanation: The Enabled and locked setting is irreversible and cannot be disabled for this cleanup.

options.text: Shorten the policy so the existing recovery points expire earlier.
options.explanation: Policy-based immutability blocks reducing retention in a way that prematurely removes retained recovery points.

options.text: Stop protection with deletion of all existing backup data immediately.
options.explanation: Deleting recovery points before their retention expiry is blocked under the stated immutability configuration.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of backup soft deletion?

options.text: Prevent any backup deletion request from being accepted.
options.explanation: Soft delete retains data after deletion; it is not the immutability control that blocks premature deletion operations.

options.text: Keep deleted backup data recoverable for its configured window.
options.explanation: Soft delete postpones permanent removal and allows recovery after accidental or malicious deletion within that window.

options.text: Provide a secondary-region copy of the backup data.
options.explanation: Soft delete addresses deletion recovery rather than the geographic redundancy of stored backup data.

options.text: Create a new recovery point containing changes since the last backup.
options.explanation: Soft delete preserves deleted backup data; it does not capture new source changes.

questions.prompt: A Backup vault has locked immutability. It manages operational Azure Disk Backup snapshots held in a snapshot resource group. A security review asks whether the vault setting establishes protection against deletion of those snapshots. Which conclusion follows?

options.text: It establishes protection because the snapshots are listed by a backup instance in the vault.
options.explanation: Management by a vault does not place operational snapshots under the vault immutability setting.

options.text: It establishes protection if the source disk uses Premium SSD.
options.explanation: The source disk SKU does not change the documented operational-backup exclusion.

options.text: It does not establish that protection; operational backups are outside the vault immutability setting.
options.explanation: Vault immutability does not apply to operational backups of disks, so their snapshot protection requires separate assessment.

options.text: It establishes protection if the snapshot resource group is in the vault’s region.
options.explanation: Regional placement does not remove the operational-tier exclusion from vault immutability.
